notes: Family Sharing now signs in with phone number + 6-digit OTP instead of email/password. New: Family Expense Tracker - once you're in a family, every SMS-auto-captured transaction syncs automatically to a shared family ledger, and the Family Dashboard shows Total Family Spend Today with a pie chart broken down by member. Family invites and Smart Split participants can now be picked directly from your Contacts instead of typing numbers by hand. Same one-time Firebase setup as before is still needed first.
